custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, and an active part, part B, both with stock.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839492 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839492-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839492-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C839492 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839492-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
    • How to do it: The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839492-.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 6.6 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Create Return page (Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then start a new return).
